label.it: Movimento verticale del suolo nel riquadro
label.en: Vertical ground motion in the box

question: How fast does the ground move in this box?
headline: median

share_down.meaning: share of the measured cells below -2.0 mm/a

share_up.meaning: share of the measured cells above +2.0 mm/a

coverage.meaning: share of the cells in the box that have a value

reliability.method: egms-client: the share of the 100 m cells in the box that have a value

notes: Only 43% of the cells have a value: the statistics describe the measured cells, not the whole box.
The data stop at the end of the window: they do not describe the ground of today.
A ground velocity is a measurement, not an alert or a safety verdict.
